subject: Kickoff: honest privacy accounting for our DP-SGD pipelines
body:
Team,

Kicking off the batch-sampler accounting effort. The uncomfortable finding from our open-source work: most DP-SGD implementations shuffle their data but report privacy guarantees computed under Poisson subsampling, and the two can diverge meaningfully — "How Private are DP-SGD implementations?" is literally the title. We also have the balls-and-bins sampler with accounting that gets the practical benefits of shuffling with provable bounds.

Product goal: every internal DP training pipeline reports epsilon computed for the sampler it actually uses. Deliverables: the accounting library integrated with the dp_accounting package interface, a sampler audit of the four internal DP pipelines, and a migration rec per pipeline.

Milestones: library API stable end of March, audit done mid-May, recs and leadership readout before Q3 OKR lock June 26.

Jelena — staffing/compute over to you.

Ximena
